name: Nevada Distribution & Control
old_description: After working for wholesalers for many years, I decided to open this business in 1998 to offer customers personal service and excellent products for less. My many industry contacts trust in me and know that I’ll provide top-tier products and services for their needs.
about:
Nevada Distribution & Control was founded in 1998 in Las Vegas, Nevada, by an owner who had previously worked for wholesalers. The owner opened the business to offer personal service and excellent products for less, leveraging longstanding industry contacts.

The company specializes in the sale of new, reconditioned, and obsolete circuit breakers, along with related electrical components such as bus plugs, motor controls, mounting hardware, panelboard switches, and transformers. It also purchases excess inventory from clients and provides testing and repair services performed by certified AVO® technicians. The firm maintains a large, constantly changing inventory of over 4,500 breaker SKUs and offers 24-hour emergency service, with next-day and same-day delivery options via UPS, FedEx, and motor freight. No minimum or maximum order quantities are imposed.

Nevada Distribution & Control serves industrial and commercial customers nationwide, including contractors, maintenance departments, and facilities that require replacement or obsolete circuit breakers from brands such as Eaton, Square D, Siemens, General Electric, and Westinghouse.

The business was started to provide personal service and top-tier products at lower cost than traditional wholesalers, a mission reflected in its two-year warranty on all reconditioned products and its emphasis on stress-free purchasing backed by a sales team with over 50 years of combined experience.
